entries.boundary: Existing format-chunker orchestration boundary returning terminal document errors
entries.reason: A format-specific chunker failure must become an explicit failed-document errors list consumed by ingestion, not successful chunks or a suppressed cancellation. The established result shape is retained with a safe message. Arbitrary format implementation exceptions require this one translation boundary; lower SDK/parser retries and optional image handling are narrowed separately. BaseException and metadata failures outside this boundary propagate.
entries.diagnostic_path: Safe document processing error and nonempty terminal errors list; no dependency payload

entries.boundary: Existing per-document NL2SQL processing failure result consumed by run aggregation
entries.reason: The established boundary converts a failed properties/read/embedding/upload operation to an explicit error record and failed per-kind count so other documents can proceed. Arbitrary adapter implementation failures must never be retried as missing documents or counted as indexed. This proposal covers only this explicit failed-result translation; expected optional-log operations are separately narrowed and cancellation is not caught.
entries.diagnostic_path: Safe error-class message, per-file status=error and run itemsFailed; no raw dependency payload

entries.boundary: Search client close in NL2SQL indexing run finally block
entries.reason: A Search cleanup failure must not replace the original listing/indexing outcome or skip subsequent Blob and credential cleanup. This preserves the pre-existing lifecycle contract while making cleanup failure visible. It covers close only, not search, upload or result aggregation.
entries.diagnostic_path: Safe Search cleanup warning; primary exception or confirmed summary remains authoritative

entries.reason: A Blob close failure must not replace a primary run failure, reverse a confirmed document result, or prevent the chained credential from closing. The existing independent cleanup sequencing is preserved with an explicit warning; no source download/listing or durable write is exempted.
entries.diagnostic_path: Safe Blob cleanup warning, followed by credential close

entries.boundary: Chained credential close after NL2SQL indexing
entries.reason: The last resource-close operation must not mask the primary run failure or convert confirmed document totals into an indexing failure. Both successful and failed runs inject a non-SDK close failure and prove that all owned cleanup calls are attempted. Credential creation/token acquisition and authorization are outside this proposal.
entries.diagnostic_path: Safe credential cleanup warning without changing the primary result

entries.boundary: Optional token-integrity debug diagnostics before independent JWT verification
entries.reason: This pre-existing debug-only boundary must not change authorization when a configured logging handler or token-length diagnostic fails. It neither returns claims nor skips the subsequent signature, issuer, audience and expiry checks. A real signed-token test injects a failing diagnostic sink and still executes full verification.
entries.diagnostic_path: Optional sink may be unavailable; primary JWT verification and its explicit HTTP failure remain authoritative

entries.boundary: Optional Microsoft Graph audience warning, not the audience validation operation
entries.reason: The established warning is diagnostic only. Logging sink failures must not replace the actual audience rejection or bypass verification. The failure test uses a real signed Graph-audience token and a failing warning sink; JWT verification still returns the established 403 Invalid token audience outcome. No decoder, key acquisition, signature or authorization operation is inside this proposal.
entries.diagnostic_path: The authoritative JWT validation returns an explicit 403 audience failure even if the optional warning cannot be emitted

entries.boundary: Per-record direct Search batch upload in the API-key ingestion endpoint
entries.reason: The established endpoint returns a 200 envelope with explicit per-record errors instead of aborting all submitted records. SDK transport and malformed-response failures must remain failed records, never inferred uploads. Confirmation is computed from matching requested keys before indexedChunks is assigned; this proposal does not cover chunking, embedding, optional Blob persistence or authorization.
entries.diagnostic_path: Per-record Batch indexing error plus stage/exception-class log without downstream payload

entries.reason: A sanitizer defect must drop an unsafe audit event, not fail an already-running ingestion operation. This record covers only the unexpected sanitizer catch, not source/configuration failures.
entries.diagnostic_path: gptrag.audit_warning: dropped event type and exception class, without exception payload

entries.reason: A failed logger/exporter must not reverse a confirmed Search outcome or turn a successful worker into a failure. Only the audit side effect is dropped; the primary result is unchanged.
entries.diagnostic_path: gptrag.audit_warning: failed export stage, event type and exception class only

entries.boundary: Run context manager observing the primary worker failure
entries.reason: Record exactly one failed terminal event and re-raise the same primary exception. The context-variable cleanup must still run; this catch never converts an indexing/purge failure to success.
entries.diagnostic_path: Correlated ingestion.run.failed event; original exception propagates to the worker caller

entries.boundary: Optional document audit projection of an existing Search response
entries.reason: Malformed audit projection must not alter the caller's primary SDK result. The write adapter separately validates confirmation; this catch does not approve or synthesize a successful upload/delete.
entries.diagnostic_path: gptrag.audit_warning: document emission failed, with exception class but no source or exception payload

entries.boundary: Local cache refresh after confirmed durable App Configuration writes
entries.reason: The established PUT contract treats only this post-write refresh as best-effort. A refresh failure must not relabel an already applied durable write as failed. Explicit reload/apply operations, remote writes and primary provider reads retain their independent failure contracts.
entries.diagnostic_path: Warning naming the post-write cache-refresh stage and exception class, without downstream payload

entries.boundary: Closing the purger-owned Search adapter in run finalization
entries.reason: Search transport cleanup must be attempted but cannot replace the original purge failure or reverse an already confirmed Search outcome. A failed close must still allow Blob and credential cleanup.
entries.diagnostic_path: NL2SQL Search-client cleanup warning with exception class only

entries.boundary: Closing the purger-owned Blob client in run finalization
entries.reason: Preserve the existing non-masking cleanup boundary while making its failure visible. A Blob close failure must not skip credential cleanup, manufacture a finished summary after a failed purge, or invalidate confirmed primary work.
entries.diagnostic_path: NL2SQL Blob-client cleanup warning with exception class only

entries.boundary: Closing the purger-owned credential after its clients
entries.reason: Credential finalization is not a new indexing/deletion operation. Preserve the original primary exception or confirmed result if credential cleanup fails, but emit a safe warning rather than silently passing.
entries.diagnostic_path: NL2SQL credential-cleanup warning with exception class only

review.rationale: Sixteen exact proposals: four audit boundaries, confirmed-write cache refresh, three purger cleanup boundaries, direct-upload per-record failure translation, two optional auth diagnostics, NL2SQL per-document failure translation, three indexer cleanup boundaries and document chunking failure translation. All require individual review; none is active.
